programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: Forensic Files: True Lies
programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Rescues a Runaway
programme.desc: Sherry was attacked at 15 and ran away from home. She wants Steve’s help with reuniting her with her mother. Then, Dawn's teenage daughter Cathy recently gave birth, but lives in fear of the baby’s unemployed and unstable father Nick.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Look What You Did to Your Baby
programme.desc: Kristy wants her baby back from her mother Donna! Donna claims she took the baby away because he was born with severe disabilities due to Kristy’s drug use during pregnancy. Who’s the liar?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Teen Mom Murderer?
programme.desc: At 17, Janelle's infant son died from serious injuries. She was sentenced to 3 years in prison for reckless homicide, but claims she's innocent. What will her polygraph results say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Shocking Betrayal
programme.desc: Korey is positive that his girlfriend Dominique is cheating on him and is also worried that she might be selling sex. She says that his suspicions have caused him to become abusive. Then, Gregory thinks that his girlfriend Robin isn’t faithful!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
programme.desc: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
programme.desc: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Mr. LA
programme.desc: A young man tries to flee a violent scene, but is shot dead behind the wheel of his car. A peculiar clue puts Kenda hot on the heels of a self-styled gangster with revenge on his mind.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Two best friends are gunned down on a dark residential street. When a string of disappointments threaten to derail the case, Kenda enlists the help of an old acquaintance.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bump In the Night
programme.desc: When a pretty, young pilot is found in bed, bound and with a bullet in her head, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if this was a random assault or payback for something that happened in the skies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Falling
programme.desc: When a family of four is brutally murdered, it sends a shockwave of fear through the town. Police believe they have a spree killer on their hands, until Lt. Joe Kenda discovers a gruesome connection.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fall From Grace
programme.desc: Hikers come across a horrific scene: the corpse of a man left nude, beaten and bound in the mountain wilderness.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill NO: Sandra Weir
programme.desc: The story of Sandra Weir, who acted as a carer for her elderly neighbor. But she was stealing from the pensioner to fund her drug addiction, leading to a tragic confrontation.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill NO: Paul Novak
programme.desc: The case of New York paramedic Paul Novak, who boasted of committing the perfect murder after the dust had settled on the death of his first wife Catherine.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill NO: Thomas Dunkley
programme.desc: The case of carer Thomas Dunkley, who aided boxer Shaun 'The Guv'nor' Cummins after he became paralysed, and later killed and dismembered his patient.

programme.title: Scammed!: Ponzi Saxton
programme.desc: In the early 20th century a man scammed people out of their savings through an elaborate plan that is now referred to as a Ponzi scheme.

programme.title: Scammed!: Butler Ponzi
programme.desc: In this episode we study the Butler case. Jeff Butler targeted elderly people for his Ponzi scheme, in which he stole over 12 million dollars from people he had befriended.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: On the Case: Blood Money

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Betrayal

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case

programme.title: Henry Danger: Piper fra fremtiden
programme.desc: Henry får uventet besøk som hevder at hun er fra fremtiden. Når en draps-robot kommer på banen, må gjengen finne en måte å redde alle sammen fra en apokalyptisk fremtid på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Søstertrøbbel Del 1
programme.desc: Pakker blir stjålet fra verandaene i Solsyn. Henry og Ray spaner for å ta tyven på fersken.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Søstertrøbbel Del 2
programme.desc: Når minnene til Ray plutselig blir borte, lager Schoz en plan for å sende Henry inn i hjernen til Ray for å finne dem.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Captain Mamma
programme.desc: Captain Man oppfører seg som en baby uten skulle ha en baby. Fødselssmerter gjør ham hjelpeløs, så Kid Danger og Piper trår til for å ta noen slimete skurker.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Synlige Brad
programme.desc: Captain Man og Kid Danger kommer til å trenge litt magi og litt hjelp fra en gammel venn, hvis de vil fange tyven.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Historie-tanken
programme.desc: Henry sier at han ikke blir skremt. Schwoz lar Henry prøve en maskin, som lar ham erfare de skumle historiene alle forteller om, i håp om å motbevise ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jule-slaget
programme.desc: En ny type møll spiser opp alle Juletrærne i byen, så Captain Man og Kid Danger drar over til Neighborville for å kjøpe flere. På veien tilbake blir de angrepet av tre skumle treselgere og må slåss for å redde julen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Sjalu-gram-veggen
programme.desc: Captain Man og Kid Danger vokter den nyeste attraksjonen, Sjalu-gram-veggen, når Captain Man ødelegger den fordi han prøver å fjerne en liten fugl. Kid Danger og Captain Man må tenke ut en måte å erstatte den på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Herr Smilemann
programme.desc: Herr Smilemann, en mann i en smilemaske som har straffet innbyggerne hvis de ikke har oppført seg ordentlig. Kid Danger og Captain Mans etterforskning leder dem til Herr Wallaby, en lokal barnetv-kjendis.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Theranos-støvel
programme.desc: Henry og de andre barna ødelegger Rays filmrekvisitt, Theranos-støvelen. For å erstatte den, reiser Henry og Jasper til et annet univers med Onde Bills inter-dimensjonale transport og stjeler deres inter-dimensjonale Theranos-støvel.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rumblr
programme.desc: Captain Man, som er lei av å slåss mot de samme, gamle skurkene, blir overtalt til å legge inn en profil på en app for helter og skurker. Kid Danger gjør det samme og de to setter opp en dobbelkamp for å gjøre opp med noen skurker.

programme.desc: Gratulerer med dagen! Vår kanalen har fått en 25 års logo får å feire bursdagen til vår kule favorite svamp! Her finner du eventyrene og bestrebelsene til SvampeBob Firkant og vennene hans i vann i den fiktive undervannsbyen Bikini Bunnen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Hav-Valp
programme.desc: Når Valpene og Cap'N Turbot er ute under den veldig sjeldne Magiske Hav Månen, begynner magiske ting å skje. Lokket av den mystiske Hav-Valp sangen blir PAW Patrol plutselig forvandlet til Hav-Valper.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene på Glatta / Valpene Redder en Basketballkamp
programme.desc: En vinterstorm skaper trøbbel for hele Adventure Bukta. // Ordfører Goodway utfordrer ordfører Humdinger's basketballag til en kamp. Det eneste Ordfører Goodway mangler er et, Basketballag!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Pizza / Valpene Redder Skye
programme.desc: Alex og Herr Porter leverer pizzadeig til et stort selskap når de mister kontrollen over bilen. Valpene må redde dem! // Skye er på vei til Jake-fjellet når hun krasjer i snøen. Ryder ringer Everest for å redde dagen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Pingvinene / Valpene Redder en Delfinunge
programme.desc: Noen har sveipet fisk av båten til Cap'n Turbot, så han kaller på Ryder og PAW Patrol som hjelper ham i etterforskningen. // Ved hjelp av sitt nye spion utstyr, inspiserer Chase båten og under dekk oppdager han en gruppe Pingviner.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Walinda / Valpene Redder et Stort Bein
programme.desc: Paw Patrol planlegger en spesiell feiring av Wally. Når han ikke kommer, må de finne hans spesielle venn Walinda. // Under Cap'n Turbots arkeologiske utgraving kommer et dinosaurbein til syne etter et steinras.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Elefantfamilie / Valpene og de Slemme Kattene
programme.desc: Valpenes kjøretur over savannen blir til en redningsaksjon og en familiegjenforening for en elefantfamilie. // Valpene må redde Adventure bukta fra de slemme kattene for å vinne en stor premie.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene lar Marshall Være Alene Hjemme / Valpene Redder Hjortefamilien
programme.desc: Når de andre valpene er på fallskjermtrening må Marshall få en gruppe med kattunger tilbake helt alene. // Ryder og PAW Patrol redder en hjortefamilie som sitter fast på den glatte isen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Venn / Valpene Redder en Blindpassasjer
programme.desc: Når Marshall bestemmer seg for å ta en pause fra Paw Control, slår valpene seg sammen for å få ham tilbake igjen. // Når Valpene finner en blindpassasjer på reisen til tundraen, må de redde en rømt kattunge i en rømt snowcat.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Den Nye Valpen
programme.desc: PAW Patrol rykker ut for å redde Jake når han blir strandet i isødet, men en ny valp dukker også opp for å gi en hjelpende pote: den modige Everest!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Bryllup / Valpene Redder Ace
programme.desc: Farmer Al og Farmer Yumi skal gifte seg! // Favoritt stuntpiloten til Skye, Ace Soarenson, er på vei til Adventure Bukta for å ha et fantastisk flyoppvisning. Like før ankomst får hun motorproblemer!

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Yakima
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt disset i et intervju om iCarly, prøver Freddie å vise sin kreative side gjennom å webb-sende iCarly i 3D. Spencer ansetter en assistent som han ikke har råd til å betale.

programme.title: iCarly: Tabber
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren som spiller Rex on Victorious, venner tilbake som vert i et dyptgående intervju med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres supergøyale tabber og bortklipte scener. Gjestestjerne: Rex fra Victorious

programme.title: iCarly: Fortsatt like gal
programme.desc: Ettr å ha fått beskjed om at Nora Dershlit blir løslatt fra fengselet, ser iCarly-gjengen på hva de kan gjøre for å holde sin gamle kidnapper bak lås og slå. Imens oppdager Freddies mor den virkelige T-Bo.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møter One Direction
programme.desc: Carly får en smittsom sykdom og kommer til å smitte et medlem i bandet One Direction. I mens skal Spencer trene en liten jente som ikke kan fordra å morsjonere.

programme.title: iCarly: Restauranten
programme.desc: Gibby åpner en hemmelig restaurant i skolens kjeller med Sams hjelp. Og Spencer designer en sikkerhetsrobot til hjemmebruk, som plutselig mister fokus helt.

programme.title: iCarly: Aprilsnarr
programme.desc: I dette spesielle aprilsnarr-avsnittet blir Carly og Spencer satt på gaten, så gjengen sitter og tenker tilbake på sin tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men minnene deres stemmer kanskje ikke alltid helt med hvordan vi husker hendelsene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dårlig stemning i butikken
programme.desc: Freddies nye drømmejobb i Pear Store blir et mareritt når Sam også blir ansatt. Imens prøver Carly å bli inviteret ut av en fra Pear Store, og Spencer må melde seg til frivillig jobb på den lokale brannstasjonen.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween
programme.desc: iCarly-gjengen holder en "Halfoween"-fest, for de syns at det skal være Halloween to ganger i året. Men da en forkledd gjest spiller Carly og vennene et puss, blir festen litt for vill.

programme.title: iCarly: Chucks lillebror
programme.desc: Et sinna barn ønsker inderlig å hevne seg, men målskiven Spencer prøver iherdig å stoppe ham. Gibby blir knust når hans nye lekelaserpistol går i stykker, men blir fra seg av henrykkelse når Freddies reparsjion gir den overraskende krefter.

programme.title: iCarly: Utestengt
programme.desc: Når Carly bannlyser T-Bo fra hennes og Spencers hjem, hevner han seg ved å ikke slippe Carly inn på Groovy Smoothie. Imens oppdager Freddie og Gibby at det fins mange fordeler ved å spille i band...og også et par ulemper.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest for at hennes venner skal venne seg til tanken på hennes og Collins spirende forhold. Men når deres støtte uteblir, tar hun drastiske midler i bruk.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt uvenner med Tamara og Ming, syns Jenna at det ikke spiller noen rolle hva hun gjør lenger - og hun havner i en vanskelig situasjon.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val ber Mr Harts klasse om å skrive og framføre et eget skuespill, og moralen i historien virker svært kjent.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Etterdønningene etter Jennas krangel med vennene gjør at hun går ut en kveld. Men det som skulle bli en kveld for å lette på trykket blir en kveld hun må reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide at Jenna kommer inn på rett spor igjen, men hun har forårsaket mer skade for sine nærmeste enn det som kan rettes opp med litt PR. Vil de tilgi henne, eller må hun ta i bruk drastiske midler?

programme.title: Awkward
programme.desc: Jenna og jentene er venner igjen og Jenna tror at hun er klar for å gjenoppta kjærlighetsaffæren med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håper at hvis hun retter opp sine feil ved å hjelpe Val med å få tilbake jobben sin, vil universet belønne henne med å sørge for at hun og Matty blir sammen igjen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna utfordres til å sette spørsmålstegn ved hvem hun vil være i denne episke sesongfinalen.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: En pinlig stund venter når vi tar en titt på de beste klippene fra 'Awkward' der skuespillerne selv kommenterer de morsomste replikkene, de saftigste forholdene og mye mer fra deres favorittepisoder av Awkward.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: The Roast of Roseanne Barr
programme.desc: Med Glees Jane Lynch som Roastmaster serveres brutale fornærmelser, og Barrs eks-mann Tom Arnold dukker opp for å harselere med sin eks-kone.

programme.title: The Roast of William Shatner
programme.desc: The Roast of William Shatner ble nominert til en Primetime Emmy Award i 2007, i kategorien Outstanding Variety Special. Her blir skuespilleren plassert i rampelyset når roastmaster Jason Alexander og en gruppe komikere jekker ham ned noen hakk.

programme.title: Another Period: Annulment
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrices ekteskap blir annullert, samt Lillian og Victor krangler om deres dyrebare 'Butternut' - rommet. Beatrice hjelper Albert med å komme over øksefobien, og Garfield krangler med en tvilsom ny tjener.

programme.title: Another Period: The Prince And The Pauper
programme.desc: Huset Commodore inviterer en prins til Bellacourt Manor. Det starter en intens rivalisering mellom Lillian og Beatrice. Peepers gir prinsens tjener motbør angående korrekte butler-metoder, og Hamishs cellekamerat prøver å lære ham å lese.

programme.title: Another Period: Trial of the Century
programme.desc: Hamish står for retten for mordet på Scoops LaPue. Lillian prøver å bruke saken for å skape blest om egen person, og Peepers nyter en siste dag i frihet før han prøver å påta seg skylden for forbrytelsen.

programme.title: Detroiters: Dream Cruise
programme.desc: Når de ansatte truer med å slutte på grunn av manglende helseforsikring, forsøker Tim og Sam å samle inn pengene de skylder fra tidligere jobber. Deres innsats forvanskes av Detroits årlige 'Dream Cruise'-bilshow. Gjest er Cecily Strong.

programme.title: Detroiters: Husky Boys
programme.desc: Tims far - 'Big Hank' - kommer uventet tilbake fra galehuset under mistenkelige forhold. Tim og Sam sliter med en å skape et slagord for en varehus-reklame som henvender seg til store, sterke karer.

programme.title: Detroiters: Quick Rick Mahorn in Dearborn
programme.desc: Tim og Sam oppdager at Chrysler-sjefen de kjørte over har hatt det forferdelig siden. Etter å ha vært med i en av reklamene, får Piston-legenden Rick Mahorn skuespillerambisjoner. Gjester er Jason Sudeikis, Rick Mahorn og Richard Karn.
